summary: A strip across the top of a page for news or a notice, loud or quiet, that slides away when dismissed.

props.name: action
props.description: A link or button at the message's end.

props.name: dismissible
props.description: Adds a button that slides the banner away.

props.name: onDismiss
props.description: Called once the banner is dismissed, such as to remember it.

props.name: tone
props.description: Filled in the fill color for news, or in the well color for a notice.

props.name: shape
props.description: Corner radius of the dismiss button. Inherits the nearest `Shape`.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes. `merge` folds them in last, so one here replaces the component's own class for the same utility.

props.name: focus
props.description: The focus outline. `true` draws it, `false` removes it, and a string of Yumma CSS utilities restyles it on every focusable part of the component, which is more than `className` reaches. Removing it outright and putting nothing back fails WCAG 2.4.7.

children.text: Yumma UI 0.15 is out, with Carousel, Diff Viewer and five more.
